body_markdown:
[PDF Version](https://ir.newamsterdampharma.com/node/10701/pdf)


NAARDEN, the Netherlands and MIAMI, Nov. 24, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- NewAmsterdam Pharma Company N.V. (Nasdaq: NAMS or “NewAmsterdam” or the “Company”), a late-stage, clinical biopharmaceutical company developing oral, non-statin medicines for patients at risk of cardiovascular disease (“CVD”) with elevated low-density lipoprotein cholesterol (“LDL-C”), for whom existing therapies are not sufficiently effective or well-tolerated, today announced that company management will participate in the following upcoming investor conferences:


- **9** **th** **Annual Evercore Healthcare Conference** in Coral Gables, FL on Monday, November 30, 2026. Michael Davidson, M.D., Chief Executive Officer, and Matthew Philippe, Executive Vice President, Head of Investor Relations, will participate in a fireside chat at 3:25 p.m. ET on Monday, November 30.
- **Citi’s 2026 Global Healthcare Conference** in Miami, FL on Tuesday, December 1, 2026. Michael Davidson, M.D., Chief Executive Officer, and Matthew Philippe, Executive Vice President, Head of Investor Relations, will participate in a fireside chat at 9:00 a.m. ET on Tuesday, December 1.
- **Piper Sandler 38th Annual Healthcare Conference** in New York, NY on Wednesday, December 2, 2026. Ian Somaiya, Chief Financial Officer, and Matthew Philippe, Executive Vice President, Head of Investor Relations, will participate in a fireside chat at 11:00 a.m. ET on Wednesday, December 2.


Live webcasts of the fireside chats will be available through the investor relations section of the NewAmsterdam Pharma website at[ir.newamsterdampharma.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=-Xif7kiBdpkolc2VysWPbLXVpvM1FhzJc6WIjuh6wmrvN1mMD51mzcWKfZ_MBI_WVIOiiRtsIKgDuULScexrTrCFXeT15S-1uo1UgB2fuH0des--3Gui05jVaIc6-XTB) . Following the live webcasts, archived replays will be available on the Company’s website.


**About NewAmsterdam**


NewAmsterdam Pharma (Nasdaq: NAMS) is a late-stage biopharmaceutical company dedicated to building a new standard of care for people living with cardiometabolic and neurodegenerative diseases. The Company is advancing therapies designed to address a significant unmet need for safe, well-tolerated, and convenient treatment options that lower LDL-C while advancing innovation beyond a single marker to better address cardiovascular risk. In multiple Phase 3 trials, NewAmsterdam is investigating obicetrapib, an oral, low-dose, once-daily CETP inhibitor, alone and as a fixed-dose combination with ezetimibe, in patients at risk of cardiovascular disease with elevated LDL-C. Guided by its mission, the Company challenges convention with courage, translates deep biological insight into meaningful patient impact, and delivers with rigor, precision, and purpose.
